entities.name: Mikaela Laurén
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mikaela Laurén is a Swedish professional boxer and former national team swimmer. In boxing she held the WBC female light middleweight title from 2014 to 2016, and has challenged once for the undisputed female welterweight championship in 2017.
